items.title: Cursor agents gain Computer Use to control local desktop apps
facts: Cursor can now control your computer. Agents can drive desktop apps like the iOS Simulator to test the features they build.
Computer Use lets agents click and type across any app on your computer, not just the browser.
Cursor uses it on its own when a task needs it. You can also ask for it by @-mentioning Computer Use in your prompt.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.310 released with Monitor tool and multiple fixes
facts: Added the Monitor tool and plugin monitors on Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry, and when telemetry or nonessential traffic is disabled; long foreground sleeps are now blocked there too.
Fixed requests failing behind some gateways and compatible servers that reject the effort-2025-11-24 beta value or mid-conversation system messages; Claude Code now retries without them.
Fixed background cleanup deleting some recent files, such as pasted images, when cleanupPeriodDays is set to a very large value.
Fixed compaction after a "Prompt is too long" error keeping too much of a conversation with dense text, such as base64 or SVG, so the next request could fail again.

x_posts.author: @MrBugia
x_posts.text:
Claude Code still says “Prompt is too long” after compaction?

Oct 23’s v2.1.310 fixes a case where dense text, such as base64/SVG, left too much context behind.

Check your version before repeatedly trimming prompts.
https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.310

items.why_hot: Regular update addressing reliability issues in cloud setups, compaction loops, and permission handling that affect daily agentic coding workflows.

items.title: GitHub Copilot usage metrics API adds client-level data for tools like OpenCode
facts: The Copilot usage metrics API now reports model usage from more of the tools your developers use with Copilot, including tools like OpenCode that weren’t previously captured in your reports.
A new totals_by_client array is available in the enterprise, organization, enterprise-user, and organization-user 1-day and 28-day reports.
Each totals_by_client entry represents one client and includes client, request_count, session_count, token_usage, and totals_by_model.

x_posts.text:

items.title: Claude Code desktop creator Anthony Morris leaves Anthropic
facts: Yesterday was my last day at Anthropic.
I created Claude Code on desktop because I believe everyone can be a builder.
Walking away from my best friends, a product I poured my heart into, and the mission was the hardest thing I’ve done in my career.

x_posts.author: @amorriscode
x_posts.text:
Yesterday was my last day at Anthropic.
 
I created Claude Code on desktop because I believe everyone can be a builder. Every feature request and bug report we got from this community was a gift that impacted millions of lives. I’m eternally grateful for those gifts, the product wouldn’t be what it is without you.
 
Anthropic is doing some of the most important work of our time. Contributing to that mission will forever be a career highlight for me. I never imagined I’d get to contribute to something so special in my lifetime.

Walking away from my best friends, a product I poured my heart into, and the mission was the hardest thing I’ve done in my career. But now I have some free time for GTA VI.

I'm already itching to get back to addressing all your feedback. I'll share what's next soon!

items.why_hot: High-engagement personal announcement from the creator of Claude Code desktop about leaving Anthropic, sparking discussion in the AI coding community about team changes.
